title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior emerges and spreads in a population under varying social influence, policies, information environments, and supply constraints, optionally coupled to disease prevalence.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use among their peers and update their adoption propensity based on social norms and susceptibility.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask policies, affecting individual compliance and potential penalties or access control.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Information sources broadcast messages that alter risk perception, beliefs about efficacy, and misinformation levels.

interactions.name: mask_purchasing
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from vendors subject to stock, price, and personal resources; inventory constraints may limit adoption.

interactions.name: contact_events
interactions.description: Co-location of individuals leads to interactions; mask usage modifies effective contact risk and can feed back to perceived risk.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Changes in disease prevalence update individual risk perception, influencing subsequent mask adoption decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily fraction of the population wearing masks.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction wearing masks at the end of the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first exceeds 50%.

metrics.name: average_compliance_by_location
metrics.description: Mean mask-wearing rates within each location type (e.g., work, retail).

metrics.name: equity_gap_in_adoption
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between high- and low-income groups.

metrics.name: misinformation_penetration
metrics.description: Average misinformation belief level across the population.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Count of days with vendor stockouts affecting potential purchases.

metrics.name: policy_effect_on_adoption
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to mandates/enforcement versus a counterfactual without policy.

metrics.name: R_effective
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number over time if the epidemiological component is enabled.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_curve_stability
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change below a small threshold (e.g., <0.5 percentage points) for a specified number of consecutive days indicates convergence.

validation_criteria.name: attribute_boundedness
validation_criteria.description: All probability-like attributes (e.g., risk perception, susceptibilities) remain within [0,1] throughout the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: inventory_nonnegativity
validation_criteria.description: Mask inventories and vendor stock never drop below zero.
